title: A quick but, even burn… not heavily scented!!
text:
A quick but, even burn… not heavily scented!!. A smaller “quick burn” candle in a fun, colorful set of 8 Mandela print tins for $16- One can create an ambience of candlelight by burning multiples at a time.. These are small so don’t expect any high output of throw- which is not be a bad thing if deciding to burn various “flavors” at one time.. No one scent will be competing with the other! TBH, the most I smell while burning x3 at once- was melting wax- and not in a unfavorable way.. just enough to let you know a candle is lit!!

These candles burn quickly compared to others. On the flipside, they burn evenly and completely to the wick- see photos I shared! (all 3 so far have performed the same way- so, nothing is wasted.) one could also reuse tin for any # of uses. Total burn- approx 5-7hr. or, x1 full afternoon/evenings worth. I also must mention these have provided a clean burn- no excess of soot, ash, smoke..

Candles are gift ready and come prewrapped with a ribbon on top! (again see photos!) double layered these would be well received upon arrival- OR, these could be separately gifted as 8 individual gifts.. there’s nothing to indicate it’s part of a set. A simple thank you, housewarming or a birthday gift to keep on hand. Used individually, these are best suited for smaller space: desk top, bathroom, table center, dorm room etc. Hoping this info can help your decision.. stay safe!
